items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: He had the band. He plays badly in Baden-Ocean.

ctx.x: No, no, his brother. Oh. He plays mostly in Baden-Ocean. What's that boy's name again, Puro? Thomas' brother, that's Pete boy. Oh, Ballerton. I mean his gift name. Freddie. George Ballerton. George Ballerton. He had the band. He plays badly in Baden-Ocean. Does someone have brass bands out here?
